'''Beast charmers''' were a subset of the society of the [[Amaran/Legends|Amaran]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. One beast charmer once wore trousers, a [[Clothing/Legends|vest]], [[Glove/Legends|gloves]], a necklace, and [[Piercing/Legends|earrings]] while holding a [[Staff/Legends|staff]]. The beast charmer held one creature in the right [[Limb/Legends|hand]] while holding another winged creature on a perch at the end of the staff.
